name: Mountaineer Stormpike
summary: At Algaz Station in northern Loch Modan, Mountaineer Stormpike watches the road into the Wetlands. A proud member of the Stormpike clan, he guards Ironforge’s supply routes from troggs and kobolds.

sections.title: Guardian of Algaz Station
sections.body: At Algaz Station, Mountaineer Stormpike guards the northern road out of Loch Modan. The station stands before the descent through Dun Algaz into the Wetlands, where rocky crags and threats from the wilderness surround it. Stormpike keeps communication open and the road clear for travelers and supply convoys crossing the pass.

sections.title: Contending with Local Menaces
sections.body: Kobolds in nearby digs and troggs from beneath the ground trouble northern Loch Modan. Stormpike asks passing adventurers to disrupt these threats. Kobolds have moved into Silver Stream Mine and taken the Miners' League's stored dwarven tools.

faq.q: Where can I find Mountaineer Stormpike?
faq.answer: Mountaineer Stormpike is at Algaz Station in northern Loch Modan, along the mountain road north through Dun Algaz toward the Wetlands.
Mountaineer Stormpike belongs to the Stormpike clan of Ironforge. He stands sentry and scouts the northern pass of Loch Modan against dangers from the wilderness.

faq.q: What threats does he deal with at Algaz Station?
faq.answer: Troggs and kobolds threaten the hillsides and quarries near Algaz Station. Stormpike works to drive them off so couriers and caravans can travel safely.

Algaz Station is an Ironforge outpost watching the border between Loch Modan and the rugged tunnels of Dun Algaz. Mountaineers use it as a waystation while patrolling the frontier and keeping the trade road clear.

faq.q: Is he related to the Stormpike Guard in Alterac Valley?
aliases: is he part of the stormpike guard
faq.answer: Mountaineer Stormpike bears the name of the prominent Stormpike clan, a dwarven lineage known across Ironforge for its fierce warriors and prospectors. His orders keep him on the passes of Loch Modan.

faq.q: What tasks does Mountaineer Stormpike give to adventurers?
faq.answer: Mountaineer Stormpike sends adventurers to recover the Miners' League's gear from Silver Stream Mine and carry his order for a new shield to Furen Longbeard, the dwarven armorsmith in Stormwind.

angles.text: As a dwarf of Ironforge, you honor a fellow mountaineer by helping Stormpike guard Khaz Modan's interior borders from scavenging vermin.
Algaz Station guards the overland route between Ironforge and Menethil Harbor in the Wetlands. Stormpike's watch helps keep that route open for the Alliance.
